verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents control owners (thoropass-docs-39, thoropass-docs-55), evidence request workflows with comments/status (thoropass-docs-20), and reminders tied to policy timelines for access reviews (thoropass-docs-4, thoropass-docs-30, thoropass-docs-53), which cover parts of a manual-evidence lifecycle. However, there is no explicit documentation of due-date fields or expiry/renewal tracking applied broadly to manual evidence artifacts beyond the access-review use case. Missing for 10: explicit due-date assignment on individual manual evidence items, generalized expiry/renewal alerts for all manual artifacts (not just access reviews), and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow in practice.
